posts.body: I'm making my own game in RPG Maker XP, but I don't know how to publish it. When I send it to my friends, the game doesn't work for them.

posts.author: Andar
posts.body:
what did you send to them?
there should be an option to archive or to deploy the game in the first or second menu, and you need to send the exe that you get from there (easier than sending the entire project folder)

posts.author: TeiRaven
posts.body:
RMXP uses something called the run-time package (RTP) that needs to either be manually imported into your project before deployment, or downloaded and installed by the player. It's all of the assets that come with the engine! It used to come separately to save on download and storage sizes.
Your friend can
download the RTP here!

posts.author: kyonides
posts.body:
Think that the RTP was an ancient mechanism that later on turned into goal-specific DLC's.
You could also manually add the default resources to your Audio and Graphics directories... if you're a patient guy, that is.

posts.author: TeiRaven
posts.body:
Patient? It took me all of five minutes, on the high end, to export and import the default assets. XP allows you to select multiple files for export, so you can save out whole folders at a time.
As long as you import them before you tell the game to not look for an RTP, they replace the files without a hitch and you don't have to redo any passability, animations, etc. Very quick process!
